name: CouchPotato
description: Delegates the download URL itself to a remote API (api.couchpota.to) — one endpoint controls delivered code. Abandoned 2020.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: CouchPotato obtains a server-provided download URL, extracts the archive, and replaces the application without verification.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | CouchPotato | https://github.com/CouchPotato/CouchPotatoServer | 7260c12 / 2020-02-04 (project abandoned — last commit 2020) | Y | Y (opt-in, `conf('automatic')`) | Y | https to `api.couchpota.to` (server-controlled indirection); download itself follows a URL returned by that API, no TLS override found | N | none — extracts zip/tar and overwrites app dir, no hash/signature check | server-supplied/unpinned — even the download URL is fetched from CouchPotato's own API (`cp.source_url` → `https://api.couchpota.to/updater/?...`), a single compromised/hijacked endpoint fully controls what code gets installed | `couchpotato/core/_base/updater/main.py:79-109` (`autoUpdate` — automatic install+restart when `conf('automatic')` set); `couchpotato/core/_base/updater/main.py:299-337` (`SourceUpdater.doUpdate` — downloads via `file.download` event, extracts zip/tar, `replaceWith()` overwrites app_dir with no verification); `couchpotato/core/media/movie/providers/info/couchpotatoapi.py:25,59-64` (`urls['updater'] = 'https://api.couchpota.to/updater/?%s'` supplies the actual download URL) |
